'''Cranberry Candy''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. Cranberry Candy is also available for purchase at the [[Ginger Island#Island South|Ginger Island Resort]] for {{Price|400}}.

==Bundles==
Cranberry Candy is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
Cranberry Candy is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Red Striped Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt013.png|24px]] It can be also used as a red dye color at the dye pots in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Cranberry Candy is not used in any [[quests]].
